title: Q3 nonrecurring note says opex 'excludes' the gain, yet the ground truth adds $18 back (contradictory requirement)
evidence: The note in B29 says: 'Q3 2024: Operating Expenses excludes $18 insurance settlement gain'. Read literally, the reported opex of 55 already excludes the gain, so no adjustment is needed (normalized opex = 55). The ground truth uses E10 '=E34+18' = 73, which only makes sense if reported opex *included* (was netted by) the gain. This $18 difference changes E9:E15, E17, E23, E24 and every projection through the averages (F7:H24). Because grading is all-or-nothing, an agent that follows the literal wording gets 0.
confirmation: Input Normalize!B29 says Q3 opex 'excludes $18 insurance settlement gain' (E34=55), yet golden E10 is '=E34+18' (73), flowing into E11:E24 and all projections. The sibling template 13_04 words the same case as 'OpEx includes $15 ... (gain)', so the 'excludes' wording here contradicts the all-or-noth
fix: Normalize!B29 note changed from 'Q3 2024: Operating Expenses excludes $18 insurance settlement gain' to '... includes $18 insurance settlement gain' (same wording as the sibling 13_04 task), so the answer key's add-back E10 = E34+18 follows from the note.
